title: Find the missing
prompt: Show the name of employees with no bonus recorded. Replace the ___.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE bonus IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE bonus = NULL;
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE bonus = 0;
wrongSolutions.why: Zero is a known value, not a missing one

title: Known emails
prompt: Show the name and email of customers who have an email on record.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL;
SELECT name, email FROM customers WHERE email <> NULL;

title: Not two, or nothing
prompt: Show the name of employees who aren't in department 2, including those with no department.
hints: department_id <> 2 skips NULLs, so add them back with OR.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE department_id <> 2 OR department_id IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE department_id <> 2;
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE department_id IS NULL;
wrongSolutions.why: Keeps only employees with no department

title: Gauge failures
prompt: Show the city and reading_date of readings where rainfall wasn't recorded.
solutions: SELECT city, reading_date FROM readings WHERE rainfall_mm IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT city, reading_date FROM readings WHERE rainfall_mm = 0;
SELECT city, reading_date FROM readings WHERE rainfall_mm IS NOT NULL;

title: Zero isn't missing
prompt: Show the name and bonus of employees with a bonus of 0 or no bonus at all. They're different cases, and both should appear.
hints: Check for 0 and for NULL separately.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus = 0 OR bonus IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus = 0;
SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus IS NULL;

title: Fix the check
prompt: This should show products in order items with no discount, but it returns nothing. Show the order_id and product_id. Fix it.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM order_items; DELETE FROM orders; DELETE FROM products; DELETE FROM customers; INSERT INTO customers VALUES (7, 'Ravi', 'Oslo', 'ravi@mail.test', '2024-05-05'), (8, 'Sara', 'Lima', NULL, '2024-06-06'), (9, 'Tom', 'Oslo', NULL, '2024-07-07'); INSERT INTO products VALUES (7, 'Stool', 'Home', 40.0, 25.0), (8, 'Cup', 'Kitchen', 9.0, 2.0), (9, 'Ink', 'Stationery', 12.5, 6.0); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (11, 7, '2024-02-28', 'shipped'), (12, 8, '2024-03-01', 'pending'), (13, 7, '2024-03-31', 'cancelled'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (11, 7, 1, 4.0), (11, 8, 3, NULL), (12, 9, 2, NULL), (13, 8, 1, NULL);

solutions: SELECT order_id, product_id FROM order_items WHERE discount IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT order_id, product_id FROM order_items WHERE discount = 0;
wrongSolutions.why: Zero isn't the same as missing

title: Small or unknown bonus
prompt: HR is reviewing bonuses. Show the name and bonus of employees whose bonus is under 3000 or isn't recorded.
hints: A plain bonus < 3000 would skip NULL rows.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM employees; DELETE FROM departments; INSERT INTO departments VALUES (5, 'Design'), (6, 'Finance'), (7, 'Ops'); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (11, 'Ivy', 5, NULL, 90000, '2019-02-01', 900, 'ivy@acme.test'), (12, 'Jon', 5, 11, 70000, '2020-06-15', NULL, NULL), (13, 'Kim', 6, 11, 70000, '2023-03-03', 300, 'kim@acme.test'), (14, 'Leo', NULL, 77, 30000, '2024-08-20', NULL, 'leo@acme.test'), (15, 'Mia', 6, 13, 55000, '2022-12-31', 0, 'mia@acme.test');

solutions: SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus < 3000 OR bonus IS NULL;

wrongSolutions.sql: SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus < 3000;
SELECT name, bonus FROM employees WHERE bonus <= 3000 OR bonus IS NOT NULL;

title: Complete records only
prompt: Show the full_name of contacts that have both an email and a phone recorded.
hints: Join two IS NOT NULL checks with AND.

cases.name: Different data
cases.setupSql: DELETE FROM contacts; INSERT INTO contacts VALUES (11, 'mary jackson', 'mary-j@club.test', '555-0111', 'Hampton', 'SILVER GOLD1'), (12, 'BOB Kahn', 'bob@CLUB.test', '555-0112', NULL, 'gold1'), (13, 'Rosa Park', 'rosa@club-test', NULL, 'Tuskegee', 'NEW'), (14, 'Ken Thompson', 'ken.t@club.test', '5550114', 'Murray', 'GOLD3');

SELECT full_name FROM contacts WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
